Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

content.text:
Built **Hex & Hollow**, a playable 2D witch RPG in `index.html`.

- Banish pursuing monsters to earn XP and level up.
- Discover **Moonbeam** and **Thorn Burst** as you progress.
- Use keyboard controls on desktop or the on-screen joystick and cast button on phones and tablets.
- Includes health and XP bars, spell selection, pause, and restart.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to cast, and 1–3 to select spells. Casting targets the nearest monster automatically.

Verified the JavaScript syntax and that the page is served successfully. I couldn’t capture a browser screenshot because Chromium isn’t installed in this environment. Assumption: the game should start as a single-page browser game without external assets.
